portal_description:
Red Hat Edge Manager is released as Technology Preview.

Red Hat Edge Manager (Technology Preview) provides simple, scalable, and security-focused management of edge devices and applications.

Edge Manager supports image-mode RHEL and container workloads that run on Podman and Docker, or Kubernetes.

Edge Manager is offered as a plugin to Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management or Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform.

This integration enables organizations to optimize the management and
orchestration of fleets of edge devices, whether the fleet is thousands of
dispersed retail point-of-sale systems, or industrial machinery on remote factory floors.
        
See the following customer and partner values:

* This solution not only helps customers manage thousands of devices, but helps scale operations.

* To manage large-scale deployments, customers need to integrate with their existing management systems, support remote configuration and over-the-air updates, and collect telemetry data for advanced analytics.

* Red Hat Edge Manager offers a simple and security-focused lifecycle
management, from onboarding to decommissioning of edge devices.

This complete, end-to-end solution empowers organizations to gain the most value from the fleets of devices that generate data, all from a centralized location.
